preferences.advancedQuantumPhysics.descr.value: On the Single Atom screen, show alpha particle tunneling and energy diagram.

playArea.value: A radioactive atom with jiggling nucleons sits in the center. You can watch it decay, observe how the nucleus changes, and reset the atom to repeat your experiment. A timeline shows the moment of each decay relative to half-life. An energy diagram shows the potential energy barrier and alpha particle energy. With a custom isotope, you can experiment with the barrier height, alpha particle energy, and half-life.

controlArea.value: You can replay the last decay and control how fast the action happens. Reset sim to start over.

{ $atom ->

alphaParticleEmitted.value: Alpha particle emitted from nucleus. Decay time, { $decayTime } seconds.

accessibleParagraph.value: Particle legend shows: Proton: red sphere. Neutron: grey sphere. Alpha Particle: cluster of 2 protons and 2 neutrons.
